lines.t: 1 Hear and seek to understand that the word of God is fire, each word a burning flame in the midst of an immense fire.
The countenance of the Lord is a fire
A flame within a fire
The glory of the Lord is perfect
A pure light, a flame within a flame
A fire engulfing all creation
Yahuwah is one
His name one
His name is in Him and is Him
YAHUAH is His name, one with Him, not separate, but one as the Father and the Son are one
A flame within a flame, within an immense fire
YAHUAH has no beginning and no end, even as His name, nothing is outside
His being is infinite
Those who pass outside creation
Enter His eternal glory
For all burned up in His devouring fire
In His everlasting flame
Yahuwah is one
His name one
His name is in Him
And is Him
Yahua is His name, one with Him
Not separate but one as the Father and the Son
All one, aflame within aflame
Within an immense fire
No one may come to the Father except through the Son
Yahushua, the purifying flame
Only the holy flame may dwell within the fire
For Yah is holy, all void of the flame
Will consume away, cease to exist
All must pass through the fire
The wicked purge, the penitent purifier
Yahweh is one, His name one, His name is in Him and is Him
Yahweh is His name, one with Him, not separate but one
As the Father and the Son are one, a flame within a flame
Within an immense fire
Within an immense fire
Yeah
Within an immense fire
